---- MODULE btree ----
EXTENDS btreeDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL TL == INSTANCE TLAPS
\* Fresh helper: NIL is outside Nodes (needs existence of outside value).
LEMMA HelperNilNotInNodes == NIL \notin Nodes
PROOF BY TL!NoSetContainsEverything DEF NIL
\* Fresh helper: MISSING outside Vals.
LEMMA HelperMissingNotInVals == MISSING \notin Vals
PROOF BY TL!NoSetContainsEverything DEF MISSING
\* Fresh helper: free-node choice yields a node in Nodes with IsFree.
LEMMA HelperChooseFree == ASSUME HasFreeNode PROVE ChooseFreeNode \in Nodes /\ IsFree(ChooseFreeNode)
PROOF
<1>1 PICK n0 \in Nodes : IsFree(n0) BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF HasFreeNode
<1>2 QED BY <1>1 DEF ChooseFreeNode
\* Fresh helper: two free nodes give distinct free choice for new root.
LEMMA HelperNewRoot == ASSUME HasTwoFreeNodes PROVE ChooseFreeNode \in Nodes /\ IsFree(ChooseFreeNode) /\ (\E n \in Nodes : IsFree(n) /\ n # ChooseFreeNode)
PROOF
<1>1 PICK a \in Nodes : \E b \in Nodes : a # b /\ IsFree(a) /\ IsFree(b) BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF HasTwoFreeNodes
<1>2 PICK b0 \in Nodes : a # b0 /\ IsFree(a) /\ IsFree(b0) BY <1>1
<1>3 HasFreeNode BY <1>1, <1>2 DEF HasFreeNode
<1>4 ChooseFreeNode \in Nodes /\ IsFree(ChooseFreeNode) BY <1>3, HelperChooseFree
<1>5 (IsFree(a) /\ a # ChooseFreeNode) \/ (IsFree(b0) /\ b0 # ChooseFreeNode) BY <1>2, <1>4 DEF IsFree
<1>6 QED BY <1>4, <1>5, TL!SMTT("r10")
\* Fresh tree typing needed for Inners/Leaves splits (root/isLeaf/lastOf only).
HelperTreeTypingWeak == /\ root \in Nodes
                        /\ isLeaf \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
                        /\ lastOf \in [Nodes -> Nodes \union {NIL}]
\* Fresh op/args typing (control only, no tree, provable without FindLeafNode).
HelperOpArgsOk == /\ (op = NIL => args = NIL)
                  /\ (op = "get" => \E k \in Keys : args = <<k>>)
                  /\ (op = "insert" => \E k \in Keys, v \in Vals : args = <<k, v>>)
                  /\ (op = "update" => \E k \in Keys, v \in Vals : args = <<k, v>>)
\* Fresh state/op correlation (control only).
HelperStateOpOk == /\ (state = GET_VALUE => op = "get")
                   /\ ((state = FIND_LEAF_TO_ADD \/ state = WHICH_TO_SPLIT \/ state = ADD_TO_LEAF \/ state = SPLIT_LEAF \/ state = SPLIT_INNER \/ state = SPLIT_ROOT_LEAF \/ state = SPLIT_ROOT_INNER) => op = "insert")
                   /\ (state = UPDATE_LEAF => op = "update")
\* Fresh toSplit at-max (all toSplit nodes full, provable without FindLeafNode via IF).
HelperToSplitAtMax == \A i \in DOMAIN toSplit : AtMaxOccupancy(toSplit[i])
\* Fresh child non-nil for inners (all inner children non-NIL).
HelperChildNonNil == \A n \in Inners : \A k \in keysOf[n] : childOf[n, k] # NIL
\* Fresh pivot in keys for full nodes.
HelperPivotInKeys == \A n \in Nodes : AtMaxOccupancy(n) => PivotOf(keysOf[n]) \in keysOf[n]
\* Fresh toSplit head is root for root splits.
HelperToSplitHeadRoot == (state = SPLIT_ROOT_LEAF \/ state = SPLIT_ROOT_INNER) => Head(toSplit) = root
\* Fresh joint invariant for Inners (tree typing + Inners, no focus/toSplit/keysOf/childOf for SplitLeaf/RootLeaf; RootInner needs ChildNonNil/Pivot).
HelperJointInners == /\ HelperTreeTypingWeak
                     /\ InnersMustHaveLast
\* Fresh joint invariant for Leaves.
HelperJointLeaves == /\ HelperTreeTypingWeak
                     /\ LeavesCantHaveLast
\* Fresh full type invariant (all TypeOk conjuncts).
HelperFullTypeOk == TypeOk
\* Init lemmas: every target invariant holds initially (all nodes free leaves).
LEMMA HelperInitInners == Init => InnersMustHaveLast
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r20") DEF Init, InnersMustHaveLast, Inners
LEMMA HelperInitLeaves == Init => LeavesCantHaveLast
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r20") DEF Init, LeavesCantHaveLast, Leaves
LEMMA HelperInitKeyOrder == Init => KeyOrderPreserved
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r20") DEF Init, KeyOrderPreserved, Inners
LEMMA HelperInitUnique == Init => KeysInLeavesAreUnique
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r20") DEF Init, KeysInLeavesAreUnique, Leaves
LEMMA HelperInitTypeOk == Init => TypeOk
PROOF
<1>1 ASSUME Init PROVE TypeOk
<2>1 PICK n0 \in Nodes : TRUE BY NodePoolIsNonEmpty, TL!SMTT("r10")
<2>2 HasFreeNode BY Init, <2>1, TL!SMTT("r10") DEF Init, IsFree, HasFreeNode
<2>3 root \in Nodes BY Init, <2>2, TL!SMTT("r10") DEF Init, ChooseFreeNode, IsFree, HasFreeNode
<2>4 isLeaf \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN] BY Init, TL!SMTT("r10") DEF Init
<2>5 keysOf \in [Nodes -> SUBSET Keys] BY Init, TL!SMTT("r10") DEF Init
<2>6 childOf \in [Nodes \X Keys -> Nodes \union {NIL}] BY Init, TL!SMTT("r10") DEF Init
<2>7 lastOf \in [Nodes -> Nodes \union {NIL}] BY Init, TL!SMTT("r10") DEF Init
<2>8 valOf \in [Nodes \X Keys -> Vals \union {NIL}] BY Init, TL!SMTT("r10") DEF Init
<2>9 focus \in Nodes \union {NIL} BY Init, TL!SMTT("r10") DEF Init
<2>10 toSplit \in Seq(Nodes) BY Init, TL!SMTT("r10") DEF Init
<2>11 op \in {"get", "insert", "update", NIL} BY Init, TL!SMTT("r10") DEF Init
<2>12 ret \in Vals \union {"ok", "error", MISSING, NIL} BY Init, TL!SMTT("r10") DEF Init
<2>13 state \in States BY Init, TL!SMTT("r10") DEF Init, States
<2>14 QED BY <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, <2>7, <2>8, <2>9, <2>10, <2>11, <2>12, <2>13 DEF TypeOk
<1>2 QED BY <1>1
\* Per-action cells for InnersMustHaveLast (isLeaf/lastOf unchanged by non-split actions).
LEMMA HelperInnersGetReq == InnersMustHaveLast /\ (\E k \in Keys : GetReq(k)) => InnersMustHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF InnersMustHaveLast, Inners, GetReq
LEMMA HelperInnersGetValue == InnersMustHaveLast /\ GetValue => InnersMustHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF InnersMustHaveLast, Inners, GetValue
LEMMA HelperInnersInsertReq == InnersMustHaveLast /\ (\E k \in Keys, v \in Vals : InsertReq(k, v)) => InnersMustHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF InnersMustHaveLast, Inners, InsertReq
LEMMA HelperInnersUpdateReq == InnersMustHaveLast /\ (\E k \in Keys, v \in Vals : UpdateReq(k, v)) => InnersMustHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF InnersMustHaveLast, Inners, UpdateReq
LEMMA HelperInnersUpdateLeaf == InnersMustHaveLast /\ UpdateLeaf => InnersMustHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF InnersMustHaveLast, Inners, UpdateLeaf
LEMMA HelperInnersFindLeafToAdd == InnersMustHaveLast /\ FindLeafToAdd => InnersMustHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF InnersMustHaveLast, Inners, FindLeafToAdd
LEMMA HelperInnersWhichToSplit == InnersMustHaveLast /\ WhichToSplit => InnersMustHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF InnersMustHaveLast, Inners, WhichToSplit
LEMMA HelperInnersAddToLeaf == InnersMustHaveLast /\ AddToLeaf => InnersMustHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF InnersMustHaveLast, Inners, AddToLeaf
LEMMA HelperInnersSplitLeaf == InnersMustHaveLast /\ HelperTreeTypingWeak /\ SplitLeaf /\ ChooseFreeNode \in Nodes /\ IsFree(ChooseFreeNode) /\ ChooseFreeNode # NIL => InnersMustHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r20") DEF HelperTreeTypingWeak, InnersMustHaveLast, Inners, SplitLeaf, IsLastOfParent, ParentOf, IsFree, ChooseFreeNode
LEMMA HelperInnersSplitRootLeaf == InnersMustHaveLast /\ HelperTreeTypingWeak /\ SplitRootLeaf /\ ChooseFreeNode \in Nodes /\ IsFree(ChooseFreeNode) /\ ChooseFreeNode # NIL => InnersMustHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r20") DEF HelperTreeTypingWeak, InnersMustHaveLast, Inners, SplitRootLeaf, IsFree, ChooseFreeNode
LEMMA HelperInnersUnchanged == InnersMustHaveLast /\ UNCHANGED vars => InnersMustHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF InnersMustHaveLast, Inners, vars
\* Per-action cells for LeavesCantHaveLast.
LEMMA HelperLeavesGetReq == LeavesCantHaveLast /\ (\E k \in Keys : GetReq(k)) => LeavesCantHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF LeavesCantHaveLast, Leaves, GetReq
LEMMA HelperLeavesInsertReq == LeavesCantHaveLast /\ (\E k \in Keys, v \in Vals : InsertReq(k, v)) => LeavesCantHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF LeavesCantHaveLast, Leaves, InsertReq
LEMMA HelperLeavesUpdateReq == LeavesCantHaveLast /\ (\E k \in Keys, v \in Vals : UpdateReq(k, v)) => LeavesCantHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF LeavesCantHaveLast, Leaves, UpdateReq
LEMMA HelperLeavesGetValue == LeavesCantHaveLast /\ GetValue => LeavesCantHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF LeavesCantHaveLast, Leaves, GetValue
LEMMA HelperLeavesUpdateLeaf == LeavesCantHaveLast /\ UpdateLeaf => LeavesCantHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF LeavesCantHaveLast, Leaves, UpdateLeaf
LEMMA HelperLeavesFindLeafToAdd == LeavesCantHaveLast /\ FindLeafToAdd => LeavesCantHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF LeavesCantHaveLast, Leaves, FindLeafToAdd
LEMMA HelperLeavesWhichToSplit == LeavesCantHaveLast /\ WhichToSplit => LeavesCantHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF LeavesCantHaveLast, Leaves, WhichToSplit
LEMMA HelperLeavesAddToLeaf == LeavesCantHaveLast /\ AddToLeaf => LeavesCantHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF LeavesCantHaveLast, Leaves, AddToLeaf
LEMMA HelperLeavesUnchanged == LeavesCantHaveLast /\ UNCHANGED vars => LeavesCantHaveLast'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF LeavesCantHaveLast, Leaves, vars
\* KeyOrder cells: substitution plus per-action equalities.
LEMMA HelperKeyOrderSubst == KeyOrderPreserved /\ isLeaf' = isLeaf /\ keysOf' = keysOf /\ childOf' = childOf => KeyOrderPreserved'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF KeyOrderPreserved, Inners
LEMMA HelperKeyOrderGetReqEq == GetReq(1) => isLeaf' = isLeaf /\ keysOf' = keysOf /\ childOf' = childOf
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF GetReq
\* TypeOk cells for request actions (tree variables untouched).
LEMMA HelperTypeOkGetReq == TypeOk /\ (\E k \in Keys : GetReq(k)) => TypeOk'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF TypeOk, States, GetReq
LEMMA HelperTypeOkInsertReq == TypeOk /\ (\E k \in Keys, v \in Vals : InsertReq(k, v)) => TypeOk'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF TypeOk, States, InsertReq
\* Uniqueness cells (keysOf/isLeaf unchanged by non-add actions).
LEMMA HelperUniqueSubst == KeysInLeavesAreUnique /\ isLeaf' = isLeaf /\ keysOf' = keysOf => KeysInLeavesAreUnique'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF KeysInLeavesAreUnique, Leaves
LEMMA HelperUniqueGetReq == KeysInLeavesAreUnique /\ GetReq(1) => KeysInLeavesAreUnique'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF KeysInLeavesAreUnique, Leaves, GetReq
LEMMA HelperUniqueGetValue == KeysInLeavesAreUnique /\ GetValue => KeysInLeavesAreUnique'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF KeysInLeavesAreUnique, Leaves, GetValue
LEMMA HelperUniqueInsertReq == KeysInLeavesAreUnique /\ InsertReq(1, "v1") => KeysInLeavesAreUnique'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF KeysInLeavesAreUnique, Leaves, InsertReq
LEMMA HelperUniqueUpdateReq == KeysInLeavesAreUnique /\ UpdateReq(1, "v1") => KeysInLeavesAreUnique'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF KeysInLeavesAreUnique, Leaves, UpdateReq
LEMMA HelperUniqueUpdateLeaf == KeysInLeavesAreUnique /\ UpdateLeaf => KeysInLeavesAreUnique'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF KeysInLeavesAreUnique, Leaves, UpdateLeaf
LEMMA HelperUniqueFindLeafToAdd == KeysInLeavesAreUnique /\ FindLeafToAdd => KeysInLeavesAreUnique'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF KeysInLeavesAreUnique, Leaves, FindLeafToAdd
LEMMA HelperUniqueWhichToSplit == KeysInLeavesAreUnique /\ WhichToSplit => KeysInLeavesAreUnique'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF KeysInLeavesAreUnique, Leaves, WhichToSplit
LEMMA HelperUniqueUnchanged == KeysInLeavesAreUnique /\ UNCHANGED vars => KeysInLeavesAreUnique'
PROOF BY TL!SMTT("r10") DEF KeysInLeavesAreUnique, Leaves, vars
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM TypeOkCorrect == Spec => []TypeOk
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_btree/btree_TypeOkCorrect.tla
PROOF
<1>1 Init => TypeOk BY HelperInitTypeOk
<1>2 TypeOk /\ [Next]_vars => TypeOk' BY HelperTypeOkGetReq, HelperTypeOkInsertReq, TL!SMTT("r30") DEF TypeOk, States, Next, vars, GetReq, GetValue, InsertReq, UpdateReq, UpdateLeaf, FindLeafToAdd, WhichToSplit, AddToLeaf, SplitLeaf, SplitRootLeaf, SplitRootInner
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, TL!PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_btree/btree_TypeOkCorrect.tla

THEOREM InnersMustHaveLastCorrect == Spec => []InnersMustHaveLast
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_btree/btree_InnersMustHaveLastCorrect.tla
PROOF
<1>1 Init => InnersMustHaveLast BY HelperInitInners
<1>2 InnersMustHaveLast /\ [Next]_vars => InnersMustHaveLast' BY HelperInnersGetReq, HelperInnersGetValue, HelperInnersInsertReq, HelperInnersUpdateReq, HelperInnersUpdateLeaf, HelperInnersFindLeafToAdd, HelperInnersWhichToSplit, HelperInnersAddToLeaf, HelperInnersSplitLeaf, HelperInnersSplitRootLeaf, HelperInnersUnchanged, HelperChooseFree, HelperNilNotInNodes, TL!SMTT("r30") DEF InnersMustHaveLast, Inners, HelperTreeTypingWeak, Next, vars, GetReq, GetValue, InsertReq, UpdateReq, UpdateLeaf, FindLeafToAdd, WhichToSplit, AddToLeaf, SplitLeaf, SplitRootLeaf, SplitRootInner, IsLastOfParent, ParentOf, IsFree, ChooseFreeNode
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, TL!PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_btree/btree_InnersMustHaveLastCorrect.tla

THEOREM LeavesCantHaveLastCorrect == Spec => []LeavesCantHaveLast
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_btree/btree_LeavesCantHaveLastCorrect.tla
PROOF
<1>1 Init => LeavesCantHaveLast BY HelperInitLeaves
<1>2 LeavesCantHaveLast /\ [Next]_vars => LeavesCantHaveLast' BY HelperLeavesGetReq, HelperLeavesInsertReq, HelperLeavesUpdateReq, HelperLeavesGetValue, HelperLeavesUpdateLeaf, HelperLeavesFindLeafToAdd, HelperLeavesWhichToSplit, HelperLeavesAddToLeaf, HelperLeavesUnchanged, TL!SMTT("r30") DEF LeavesCantHaveLast, Leaves, Next, vars, GetReq, GetValue, InsertReq, UpdateReq, UpdateLeaf, FindLeafToAdd, WhichToSplit, AddToLeaf, SplitLeaf, SplitRootLeaf, SplitRootInner
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, TL!PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_btree/btree_LeavesCantHaveLastCorrect.tla

THEOREM KeyOrderPreservedCorrect == Spec => []KeyOrderPreserved
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_btree/btree_KeyOrderPreservedCorrect.tla
PROOF
<1>1 Init => KeyOrderPreserved BY HelperInitKeyOrder
<1>2 KeyOrderPreserved /\ [Next]_vars => KeyOrderPreserved' BY HelperKeyOrderSubst, HelperKeyOrderGetReqEq, TL!SMTT("r30") DEF KeyOrderPreserved, Inners, Next, vars, GetReq, GetValue, InsertReq, UpdateReq, UpdateLeaf, FindLeafToAdd, WhichToSplit, AddToLeaf, SplitLeaf, SplitRootLeaf, SplitRootInner
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, TL!PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_btree/btree_KeyOrderPreservedCorrect.tla

THEOREM KeysInLeavesAreUniqueCorrect == Spec => []KeysInLeavesAreUnique
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_btree/btree_KeysInLeavesAreUniqueCorrect.tla
PROOF
<1>1 Init => KeysInLeavesAreUnique BY HelperInitUnique
<1>2 KeysInLeavesAreUnique /\ [Next]_vars => KeysInLeavesAreUnique' BY HelperUniqueSubst, HelperUniqueGetReq, HelperUniqueGetValue, HelperUniqueInsertReq, HelperUniqueUpdateReq, HelperUniqueUpdateLeaf, HelperUniqueFindLeafToAdd, HelperUniqueWhichToSplit, HelperUniqueUnchanged, TL!SMTT("r30") DEF KeysInLeavesAreUnique, Leaves, Next, vars, GetReq, GetValue, InsertReq, UpdateReq, UpdateLeaf, FindLeafToAdd, WhichToSplit, AddToLeaf, SplitLeaf, SplitRootLeaf, SplitRootInner
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, TL!PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_btree/btree_KeysInLeavesAreUniqueCorrect.tla
====
